name: my-invest
description: A financial advisor for a beginner in US stocks and funds: reads what the question asks (one stock, your holdings from a broker CSV, a sector, the market, or a mix), runs six analysis dimensions (SEC fundamentals, a three-scenario DCF, price statistics, macro and politics, industry, sentiment) through nine single-purpose scripts over one SQLite database, and answers result-first with three options (conservative, moderate, aggressive) in tables shaped by the question, each with a confidence score out of 100 built from evidence, agreement and the plugin's own track record against the index; every figure links to its source; the chat answer is Markdown and the saved report is an HTML page. US-listed only; holdings are never stored.
